text: Really sorry to bother you this late. My daughter is 19 months and has chickenpox, the spots came out yesterday and they're really itchy but she's been fine otherwise. Her temperature just read 40 though, which I think is quite high? There's also some redder blotchy bits round the spots but they go pale when I press a glass on them. She's wide awake, chatting away and watching her programme, so maybe I'm worrying for nothing. I just wasn't sure if 40 is too high with chickenpox. Sorry again.
